description: Your Canvas To Do list (the Planner) for a date range, across every course: assignments, quizzes, discussions, pages and your own notes, with plannable IDs for mark_planner_item_done.

course_id.description: Only this course (numeric ID from list_courses).

end_date.description: End of the range, YYYY-MM-DD. Default 14 days from now.

incomplete_only.description: If true, leave out items you have already submitted or marked done.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return (one page of results). Smaller is faster.

start_date.description: Start of the range, YYYY-MM-DD. Default today.

name: list_planner_items
title: List Planner Items
